title: Examination Compliance
summary: Built for non-programmable, non-CAS, non-graphing rules across Australian states and NCEA (NZ).

body.text: No user program memory, no CAS, and no function graphing keep the fx-82AU PLUS II inside common Oceania exam policies. Always confirm the current year’s approved list for your board.
VERIF and exact surds help checking work; written method is still required where the syllabus demands it.
